reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is byte-identical to the originals with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports the preferred position: § 4.1 (p0052) makes Charges payable only as specified in Service Option Attachments/Order Forms on a one-time, installment, recurring or usage basis — i.e., for ordered services or actual usage, with no minimum, shortfall or take-or-pay language anywhere in the supplied text.

§ 3.4 (p0044) gives Customer a termination-for-convenience right at the end of any calendar month, so even if an attachment contained a commitment there would be an exit, satisfying the rule's core concern.

p0142 (Capacity Planning) allocates planning responsibility to Customer but imposes no committed volume or capacity floor, so it is correctly not treated as a commitment; the residual early-termination-charge reference in p0046 is properly noted as a diligence point in the rationale rather than over-flagged as a deviation.
No deterministic check failures; nothing in the record contradicts the compliance conclusion.
